threads_project_activity_idx.name: threads_project_activity_idx
threads_project_activity_idx.where: "threads"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."deleted_at" IS NULL

threads_agent_pin.name: threads_agent_pin
threads_agent_pin.value: ("threads"."agent_id" IS NULL) = ("threads"."agent_version" IS NULL) AND ("threads"."agent_version" IS NULL OR "threads"."agent_version" > 0)

runs_compaction_idx.name: runs_compaction_idx
runs_compaction_idx.where: "runs"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "runs"."events_compacted_at" IS NULL

runs_started_at.name: runs_started_at
runs_started_at.value: "runs"."status" NOT IN ('running', 'waiting_approval') OR "runs"."started_at" IS NOT NULL

runs_events_compacted_at.name: runs_events_compacted_at
runs_events_compacted_at.value: "runs"."events_compacted_at" IS NULL OR "runs"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL

break_glass_grants_window.name: break_glass_grants_window
break_glass_grants_window.value: ("break_glass_grants"."starts_at" IS NULL) = ("break_glass_grants"."expires_at" IS NULL) AND ("break_glass_grants"."starts_at" IS NULL OR ("break_glass_grants"."expires_at" > "break_glass_grants"."starts_at" AND "break_glass_grants"."expires_at" <= "break_glass_grants"."starts_at" + interval '24 hours'))

break_glass_grants_approved_shape.name: break_glass_grants_approved_shape
break_glass_grants_approved_shape.value: "break_glass_grants"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("break_glass_grants"."approver_id" IS NOT NULL AND "break_glass_grants"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL)
